effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: soft colour turning slowly in a six-fold mirrored rosette, folded by the symmetry library and coloured in OKLCH, in one fragment pass through the HDR tail. Every later effect starts from this shape.

useCases: The template for new effects; a calm dark hero at a pinch

effects.title: Chroma bloom
effects.summary: Colour enhancement, the first and gentlest visual: a muted landscape whose colour rises and whose hues drift slowly apart, region by region, while every pixel keeps its lightness exactly. Nothing gets brighter or darker, so nothing flashes. Beside it, what CSS saturate() and hue-rotate() do to the same scene.

scorecard.fallback: A still; or the page’s own image with CSS saturate(), which changes lightness.
useCases: A hero image that blooms into colour

effects.title: Hue cycle
effects.summary: Palette cycling, the cheapest moving psychedelic image there is: rings, a rosette or a Truchet tiling, coloured by a palette that slides through them, so colour flows while nothing moves. The palette is OKLCH stops you can edit, and its contrast and speed are held under the pattern and flash limits whatever it is.

scorecard.fallback: A still; or a repeating-radial-gradient with an animated custom property.
useCases: A loader or a small badge
A section background on a music or festival site

effects.title: Kaleidoscope
effects.summary: Drifting coloured glass seen through mirrors: two mirrors at an angle (a rosette), or the four mirror shapes that tile the plane (a square, and the 45-45-90, 60-60-60 and 30-60-90 triangles). Every pixel is folded into the mirrors’ fundamental domain and reads the glass there, so the mirrors meet without a seam.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the kaleidoscope; a conic-gradient wedge repeated by rotation for 6 to 12 wedges.
useCases: A hero or section background on a music, festival or art site
